description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Notify to convene the  meeting  for the Election of Vice Chairman of Delft Pradeshiya Saba in Northen Province
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the reconvening of a meeting for the election of a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Delft Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. This content directly relates to electoral processes at the local government level, specifically the scheduling of an election meeting, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
